currentWork.title: Field maintenance — per-machine bring recommendation opt-in
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.19 candidate is preview-verified. The per-machine vehicle bring recommendation control is restored with a strict default-OFF policy. Existing machines without the setting are treated as OFF; new machines start OFF; only machines explicitly switched ON can produce bring-from-vehicle recommendations or contribute to the end-of-day next-workday loading proposal. General sales learning, demand forecasts, visit planning, tasks, orders, and OCR behavior remain active regardless of this setting. The dedicated opt-in browser/IndexedDB gate, main-app smoke gate, visit closeout gate, and OCR field regression gate pass on the READY Vercel preview. Analytics engine is AN14B3B4; DB/schema remain 4.
scope: Expose an ON/OFF control in both existing-machine details and new-machine setup.
Treat missing legacy values as OFF and initialize every newly created machine to OFF.
Pass the explicit boolean through the read-only legacy-to-Analytics bridge.
Filter only machine bring-from-vehicle and end-of-day vehicle-loading proposals by this opt-in.
Do not disable sales observations, forecasts, generic sales recommendations, or visit planning when the setting is OFF.
Keep proposal-only behavior: no automatic inventory movement, schedule write, confirmation, or machine link.
nextActions: Open and merge the bounded FINAL.19 maintenance PR after diff/status review.
Verify the matching production deployment, GitHub Pages FINAL.19, and live regression gates.
Return to field use; enable the setting only on machines where vehicle bring proposals are desired.
